description: Approximate between sRGB and CMYK. Pass `value` as hex (#1a2b3c), rgb(26,43,60) or cmyk(60,40,40,100). Returns the other model by a plain formula (K = 1 - max(R,G,B); C = (1 - R - K) / (1 - K); and R = 255 x (1 - C)(1 - K) back), total ink, and gamut cautions. This ships NO Pantone or other licensed color data: if you pass a spot name such as 'PANTONE 485 C', it tells you to look the value up in your licensed swatch book or Adobe's libraries and paste the RGB or CMYK here. APPROXIMATION ONLY: real conversion needs an ICC profile and the paper; the printed color will differ. Proof it.
name: approx_print_colour
title: Screen and print color approximation
